name: Progression
summary: XP, levels and tiers, achievements, streaks and daily challenges; skill trees a panel draws and a save keeps; and the genre-agnostic feature modules (knowledge, proficiency, patterns, gamification, adaptive difficulty, conversation analytics), each enabled module doing something or refused with a reason.

parameters.doc: XP per turn past the long-conversation mark (5)
turns before the long-conversation bonus starts (5)
XP for a quest that names no reward of its own (25)
XP per skill point a quest's skill rewards grant (2)
how much a daily-challenge streak day adds to the multiplier, in tenths (1)
the streak multiplier's cap, in tenths (20 = 2.0x)
recent quests the difficulty adjustment reads (10)
performance, in permille, at which quests get harder (850)
performance, in permille, at or below which quests get easier (400)
today's date as YYYY-MM-DD, from the host's clock; the tracker's day step takes it

extensionPoints.doc: a world's own XP curve and tier labels; the genre bundle's gamification.tierLabels by default
the trees a world authors; a node's requires are Prolog goals and its effects unlock, modify and permit
the modules a world enables; a host shows tabs and toggles only for the enabled ones
a quest's XP and counters (the tracker's quest step, once per completion)
a toast; a skill panel refreshes

assistant.summary: src/progression/gamification.ts is the tracker (XP, levels, tiers, achievements, daily challenges, streaks) as pure steps over plain state; src/progression/feature-modules.ts defines the feature modules, resolves a world's enabled ones and holds proficiency, adaptive difficulty and the quest difficulty adjustment; src/skills/ and SkillProgression own the skill trees; src/progression/progression-save.ts is the extensions.progression block. The engine draws the XP bar, the toasts and the skill panel.
notes: Feed each thing that happened to the tracker once: a quest completion is one quest step (with its category and XP reward when the host has them), not quest_completed and a direct call both.
Give the tracker today's date (a day step) from the host's clock; without one, no daily challenge is tracked.

Hand resolveFeatureModules(resolution.bundle.featureModules, resolution.bundle.id).enabled to the pause menu: performance-scoring and world-lore are refused (unimplemented, catalog progression-performance-scoring-world-lore, core-only), assessment and npc-exams are refused (port-later), so their tabs and toggles do not show.
The NPC exam half of the tracker (its XP, examsPassed, Exam Ace) waits for language-npc-exams (port-later): do not raise or count npc_exam_completed from this pack.

Level-up rewards (progression-level-up-rewards) and content gating (progression-content-gating) are port-later: level_up.rewards is always empty, and core's ContentGatingManager is not part of this pack. Do not generate either from this pack.
Restore SkillProgression from extensions.progression.skills with restore(), then publishActors and publishModifiers as a live world needs.
doNot: Store a level, a tier or the day's template in a save: they are derived from XP and the date.
Show a tab or toggle for a refused feature module.
